notes: Official page/API distance is 13 km, GPX desc says Total: 13.5 km, computed official GPX length is about 13.434 km and OSM relation length is about 13.611 km.
Official API geo_json is complete and matches GPX, while line.geometry is absent/null.
Main-thread tokenized K9 query returned 20 official places; the official-source lane reported 21, including Burgers & Dreams.
Official-source lane reports the Toalett Birger Pers väg description mentions drinking water, but the main dricksvatten category query returned only Hökafältet and Snapparp.
OSM relation 20187273 matches K9 identity but is reverse-direction relative to official order, denser and about 13.611 km, with endpoint gaps around 13-19 m.
OSM has shelter objects near bus stops, but they are public-transport shelters, not trail overnight shelters.
